exercises.instructionEn: READING TEXT 2 - MAY FESTIVALS: 1st May is called May Day in Britain.
exercises.instructionUz: 2-MATN — MAY BAYRAMLARI: Britaniyada 1-may 'May Day' deb ataladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKINChI MATN — MAY FESTIVALS.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  '1st May is called May Day in Britain
   and there are lots of different
   TRADITIONS and festivals to CELEBRATE
   the first day of spring.

   In many English towns and villages the
   local people dance around a maypole
   which is decorated with flowers and
   RIBBONS. They also choose a PRETTY
   young girl to be the May Queen. She
   then LEADS a parade around the streets
   and Morris Dancers wear flowers and
   bells and perform a special dance.

   In Padstow in Cornwall, the May Day
   celebrations include the Hobby Horse
   Festival. Two men wear costumes and
   MASKS and go around the town followed
   by dancers and musicians.

   Well dressing is another May Day
   tradition. Villagers decorate the
   drinking wells with pictures made from
   CLAY and flowers and people come from
   far away to admire them.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Britaniyada 1-may "May Day" deb ataladi
   va bahorning birinchi kunini nishonlash
   uchun turli an'ana va bayramlar bor.

   Ko'plab ingliz shaharcha va qishloqlarida
   mahalliy aholi gullar va lentalar bilan
   bezatilgan may ustuni atrofida raqsga
   tushadi. Ular yana chiroyli yosh qizni May
   malikasi qilib tanlashadi. So'ng u ko'chalar
   bo'ylab saylga boshchilik qiladi, Morris
   raqqoslari esa gul va qo'ng'iroq taqib,
   maxsus raqs ijro etishadi.

   Kornuolldagi Padstou shahrida May kuni
   tantanalariga Hobby Horse bayrami ham
   kiradi. Ikki erkak libos va niqob kiyib,
   raqqoslar va musiqachilar hamrohligida
   shahar aylanadi.

   Quduq bezash — May kunining yana bir
   an'anasi. Qishloq aholisi ichimlik
   quduqlarini loy va gullardan yasalgan
   suratlar bilan bezatadi, odamlar esa
   ularni tomosha qilgani uzoqdan kelishadi.'


⚠⚠ 'A HOBBY HORSE' — 6-BANDDAGI TUZOQ:

  'a hobby horse' — HAQIQIY OT EMAS!

  Bu — odam kiyadigan, ot ShAKLIDAGI
  libos yoki tayoqqa o'rnatilgan ot boshi.

  ⚠ Matnning o'zi buni aytadi:
  'Two men wear COSTUMES and MASKS'.

  ⚠ Shuning uchun 162-betdagi 6-band
  ('There are horses in the procession')
  javobi M emas, L.

  ⚠ 'a hobby' = mashg'ulot, ermak —
  so'z shundan kelib chiqqan (bolalar
  o'yinchog'i bo'lgan).


⚠ 'MORRIS DANCERS' KIM:

  Angliyaning qadimiy xalq raqs guruhlari.

  ⚠ Oq kiyim kiyib, oyoqlariga
  QO'NG'IROQ bog'lashadi, qo'llarida
  ro'molcha yoki tayoq bo'ladi.

  ⚠ Matnda: 'wear flowers and BELLS'.


⚠ 'WELL DRESSING' — QIZIQ AN'ANA:

  'a well' = QUDUQ
  'to dress' = kiyintirmoq, bezamoq

  ⚠ 'well dressing' = quduqni bezash.

  Qishloq aholisi ichimlik quduqlarini
  loy taxta ustiga gul barglaridan surat
  yasab bezatadi.

  ⚠⚠ ADAShTIRMANG:
     'a well' = quduq (OT)
     'well' = yaxshi (RAVISh)
     'Well, ...' = 'xo'sh, ...' (kirish so'z)

  ⚠ Bu — bir xil yoziladigan uch xil so'z.


⚠ '1ST MAY' — TARTIB SON:

  '1st May' o'qilishi:
     'the FIRST of May'

  ⚠ Britaniyada sana shunday yoziladi:
     1st May / 1 May
     ⚠ AmE: May 1st

  ⚠ 'the first DAY of spring' — 'day' bu
  yerda BOR, chunki 'birinchi KUN' degani.


⚠ 'IS CALLED' — MAJHUL NISBAT:

  '1st May IS CALLED May Day.'
     = 1-may 'May Day' deb ATALADI.

  ⚠ 157-betdagi 'Montreal is called the
  Paris of North America' bilan bir xil.


⚠ 'FOLLOWED BY' — MAJHUL NISBAT:

  'go around the town FOLLOWED BY dancers
   and musicians'
     = raqqoslar va musiqachilar
       hamrohligida

  ⚠ So'zma-so'z: 'ular tomonidan
  ergashilgan holda'.


⚠ 'MADE FROM' va 'MADE OF':

  'pictures MADE FROM clay and flowers'

  ⚠ 'made FROM' — material o'zgargan,
     tanib bo'lmaydi
  ⚠ 'made OF' — material ko'rinib turadi
     ('a table made OF wood')

  ⚠ Bu yerda gul va loydan SURAT yasalgan —
  material shakl o'zgartirgan, shuning
  uchun 'from'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  May Day     = 1-may bayrami
  a ribbon    = lenta
  to lead     = boshchilik qilmoq
  a bell      = qo'ng'iroq
  to perform  = ijro etmoq
  a mask      = niqob
  a hobby horse = ot shaklidagi libos
  a well      = quduq
  well dressing = quduq bezash
  clay        = loy
  a villager  = qishloq aholisi
  to admire   = qoyil qolmoq
  from far away = uzoqdan
  local       = mahalliy

exercises.instructionEn: READING TEXT 3 - COWES WEEK: The Isle of Wight is a small island on the south coast of England.
exercises.instructionUz: 3-MATN — COWES HAFTALIGI: Uayt oroli — Angliyaning janubiy sohilidagi kichik orol.
exercises.explanationUz:
UChINChI MATN — COWES WEEK.

  ⚠ Sarlavhasi 162-betda (pushti harflar
  bilan), matni esa shu betda.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  'The Isle of Wight is a small island on
   the south coast of England. The sea
   around the island is PERFECT for
   SAILING. Perhaps that's why the small
   port of Cowes has become one of the
   most important centres for yachting in
   the world.

   The HIGHLIGHT of the year is Cowes
   Week, which takes place in early August
   and DATES BACK to 1826. More than 1,000
   boats come to Cowes for the many
   different RACES. Thousands of people
   watch from the port or from one of the
   hundreds of SPECTATOR boats. After each
   day's sailing, there are lots of yacht
   club parties, balls and PUBLIC events.
   On the last day there is a huge
   firework display. Members of the royal
   family come to visit and everybody has
   a great time on this FRIENDLY and
   beautiful island.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Uayt oroli — Angliyaning janubiy
   sohilidagi kichik orol. Orol atrofidagi
   dengiz yelkanda suzish uchun mukammal.
   Ehtimol shuning uchun Cowes degan kichik
   port dunyodagi eng muhim yaxta sporti
   markazlaridan biriga aylangan.

   Yilning eng yorqin voqeasi — Cowes
   haftaligi; u avgust boshida o'tkaziladi
   va 1826-yilga borib taqaladi. Turli
   poygalar uchun Cowesga mingdan ortiq
   qayiq keladi. Minglab odamlar portdan
   yoki yuzlab tomoshabin qayiqlaridan biridan
   tomosha qiladi. Har kungi suzishdan keyin
   yaxta klubi ziyofatlari, ballar va ommaviy
   tadbirlar bo'ladi. Oxirgi kuni ulkan salyut
   bo'ladi. Qirol oilasi a'zolari ham tashrif
   buyuradi va bu mehmondo'st, go'zal orolda
   hamma zavq oladi.'


⚠ 'THE ISLE OF WIGHT':

  'an isle' = orol (she'riy/eski shakl)
  'an island' = orol (oddiy shakl)

  ⚠ Ikkalasida ham 's' JIM!
     'isle' [ayl]
     'island' [AY-lənd]

  ⚠ Joy nomlarida 'Isle' saqlanib qolgan:
     the Isle of Wight
     the Isle of Man


⚠⚠ 'DATES BACK TO' — MUHIM IBORA:

  'Cowes Week ... DATES BACK TO 1826'
     = 1826-yilga borib taqaladi

  ⚠ 'to date back to' = ... dan beri
  mavjud bo'lmoq, tarixi shundan
  boshlanmoq.

  ⚠ HOZIRGI ZAMONDA ishlatiladi:
     'It DATES back to 1826.'  ✓
     'It DATED back to 1826.'  ✗


⚠ 'THE HIGHLIGHT' = ENG YORQIN VOQEA:

  'high' + 'light' = 'yuqori' + 'yorug'lik'

  ⚠ 'the highlight of the year' = yilning
  eng yodda qoladigan voqeasi.

  ⚠ 'to highlight' (fe'l) = bo'yab
  belgilamoq — 162-betdagi 'highlighted
  words' shundan.


⚠ 'A RACE' — IKKI MA'NO:

     'a race' = POYGA
        'many different races' ← bu yerda
     'a race' = IRQ, xalq
        'people of all races'

  ⚠ Kontekstga qarab aniqlanadi.


⚠ 'MORE THAN 1,000' va 'HUNDREDS OF':

     'MORE THAN 1,000 boats' — ANIQ raqam
     'HUNDREDS OF spectator boats' —
        noaniq ko'plik
     'THOUSANDS OF people' — noaniq ko'plik

  ⚠ QOIDA:
     aniq raqam bilan → 'a thousand',
        'two hundred' (KO'PLIK YO'Q)
     'of' bilan → 'thousandS of',
        'hundredS of' (KO'PLIK BOR)


⚠ 'EACH DAY'S SAILING' — EGALIK:

  'After each DAY'S sailing'
     = har kungi suzishdan keyin

  ⚠ Vaqt bildiruvchi so'zlarda ham egalik
  apostrofi ishlatiladi:
     today's lesson  = bugungi dars
     a day's work    = bir kunlik ish
     two weeks' time = ikki hafta


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an isle      = orol
  an island    = orol
  a coast      = sohil
  perfect for  = ... uchun mukammal
  sailing      = yelkanda suzish
  perhaps      = ehtimol
  a highlight  = eng yorqin voqea
  to date back to = ... ga borib taqalmoq
  a race       = poyga; irq
  a spectator  = tomoshabin
  a ball       = bal (raqs kechasi)
  public       = ommaviy
  the royal family = qirol oilasi
  a member     = a'zo
  friendly     = mehmondo'st

points.en: The Isle of Wight is a small island on the south coast of England.
points.uz: Uayt oroli — Angliyaning janubiy sohilidagi kichik orol.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ 'ISLE' va 'ISLAND' — ikkalasida ham 's'
JIM!
  'isle' [ayl]
  'island' [AY-lənd]

⚠ Joy nomlarida eski 'Isle' shakli saqlangan:
the Isle of Wight, the Isle of Man.

⚠ 'ON the coast' — 'on' bilan.

points.en: The sea around the island is perfect for sailing.
points.uz: Orol atrofidagi dengiz yelkanda suzish uchun mukammal.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'perfect' — 2c mashqidagi ta'kidlangan
so'z (sinonimi: 'ideal').

⚠ 'perfect FOR' — 'for' bilan.

⚠ 'sailing' = yelkanda suzish
('a sail' = yelkan).

points.en: The highlight of the year is Cowes Week, which takes place in early August and dates back to 1826.
points.uz: Yilning eng yorqin voqeasi — Cowes haftaligi; u avgust boshida o'tkaziladi va 1826-yilga borib taqaladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ 'to DATE BACK TO' = ... ga borib
taqalmoq. HOZIRGI zamonda ishlatiladi:
  'It DATES back to 1826.'  ✓
  'It dated back to 1826.'  ✗

⚠ 'the HIGHLIGHT' = 'high' + 'light' —
yilning eng yodda qoladigan voqeasi.

⚠ 'in EARLY August' = avgust BOSHIDA;
'in LATE August' = avgust oxirida.

points.en: Thousands of people watch from the port or from one of the hundreds of spectator boats.
points.uz: Minglab odamlar portdan yoki yuzlab tomoshabin qayiqlaridan biridan tomosha qiladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu gap 162-betdagi 1-bandga javob: C.

⚠⚠ 'THOUSANDS OF' va 'HUNDREDS OF' —
noaniq ko'plikda 's' BOR.
Lekin aniq raqam bilan YO'Q:
  'more than 1,000 boats'
  'two hundred boats'

⚠ 'a spectator' = tomoshabin
('spectacular' bilan bir ildizdan).

points.en: After each day's sailing, there are lots of yacht club parties, balls and public events.
points.uz: Har kungi suzishdan keyin yaxta klubi ziyofatlari, ballar va ommaviy tadbirlar bo'ladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'each DAY'S sailing' — VAQT bildiruvchi
so'zda egalik apostrofi:
  today's lesson, a day's work,
  two weeks' time

⚠⚠ 'BALLS' bu yerda = BALLAR (raqs
kechalari), to'plar EMAS! Soxta do'st.

⚠ 'public events' = ommaviy tadbirlar.

points.en: On the last day there is a huge firework display.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ 162-betdagi 5-BAND MUAMMOSI SHU YERDA.

Lord Mayor's Show matnida ham AYNI shunday
gap bor: 'At the end of the parade there is
a spectacular firework display.'

⚠ Ya'ni 5-band javobi HAM 'L', HAM 'C'.
Kitob bitta harf kutgan bo'lsa kerak, lekin
matnlar ikkalasini ham tasdiqlaydi.

points.en: Everybody has a great time on this friendly and beautiful island.
points.uz: Bu mehmondo'st va go'zal orolda hamma zavq oladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'friendly' — 2c mashqidagi ta'kidlangan
so'z (sinonimi: 'welcoming').

⚠⚠ 'friendly' — SIFAT, ravish EMAS!
'-ly' bilan tugagani chalg'itadi.

⚠ 'to have a great time' = zavq olmoq,
yaxshi vaqt o'tkazmoq.

⚠ 'everybody HAS' — birlik fe'l!

exercises.instructionEn: Calendar of Events: here are some more important UK festivals and events.
exercises.instructionUz: Bayramlar taqvimi: Britaniyaning yana bir necha muhim bayram va tadbirlari.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 12 OY — 12 TA BRITANIYA BAYRAMI.

  Kitob har oyga bittadan tadbir bergan.


⚠⚠ KITOB XATOSI:

  Taqvimda: 'September — BRAEMER Royal
  Highland Gathering'

  ⚠ To'g'ri yozilishi — BRAEMAR.

  Bu — Shotlandiyaning Aberdinshir
  hududidagi qishloq nomi. O'yinlar ham
  shu nom bilan ataladi.

  ⚠ Rasmni kattalashtirib tekshirdim:
  kitobda aniq 'Braemer' bosilgan.


HAR BAYRAM HAQIDA QISQAChA:

  YANVAR — Burns Night (25-yanvar)
     Shotland shoiri Robert Berns
     tug'ilgan kun. Shotlandiyada
     an'anaviy taom ('haggis') yeyiladi
     va uning she'rlari o'qiladi.

  FEVRAL — Pancake Day
     Ro'zadan oldingi seshanba. Uyda
     qo'ymoch (pancake) pishiriladi.
     ⚠ Ba'zi joylarda 'pancake race' —
     qo'lda tovada qo'ymoch bilan yugurish
     poygasi bo'ladi!

  MART — Mother's Day
     ⚠ Britaniyada MARTDA (Amerikada esa
     mayda!) — bu farq muhim.

  APREL — April Fool's Day (1-aprel)
     Aldash kuni. ⚠ Hazil faqat TUShGACHA
     qilinadi — bu qadimiy qoida.

  MAY — Brighton Arts Festival
     Brayton shahridagi san'at festivali.

  IYUN — Royal Ascot Races
     Mashhur ot poygasi. ⚠ Ayollarning
     katta shlyapalari bilan mashhur.

  IYUL — Henley Royal Regatta
     Temza daryosidagi eshkak eshish
     poygasi.

  AVGUST — Notting Hill Carnival
     Londondagi Karib havzasi karnavali —
     Yevropadagi eng yirik ko'cha
     bayramlaridan biri.

  SENTABR — Braemar Royal Highland
     Gathering
     Shotland tog' o'yinlari: og'ir tosh
     otish, qarag'ay ustuni ag'darish,
     volinka chalish.
     ⚠ Kitobda 'Braemer' deb xato yozilgan.

  OKTABR — Halloween (31-oktabr)
     Qovoqdan chiroq yasash, liboslar.

  NOYABR — Bonfire Night (5-noyabr)
     'Guy Fawkes Night' ham deyiladi.
     Gulxan va salyut.
     ⚠ 162-betdagi Lord Mayor's Show ham
     noyabrda!

  DEKABR — New Year's Eve (31-dekabr)
     Yangi yil arafasi.


⚠ OYLAR — HAR DOIM BOSh HARF BILAN:

     January, February, March...

  ⚠ Kunlar ham: Monday, Tuesday...
  ⚠ O'zbek tilida kichik harf bilan.


⚠ 'EVE' NIMA:

  'an eve' = arafa (bayramdan oldingi
  kech)

     New Year's Eve  = Yangi yil arafasi
        (31-dekabr)
     Christmas Eve   = Rojdestvo arafasi
        (24-dekabr)

  ⚠ 'evening' so'zi bilan bir ildizdan.

pairs.whyUz:
Shotland shoiri Robert Berns (1759-1796)
tug'ilgan kun.

Shotlandiyada an'anaviy taom 'haggis'
yeyiladi va uning she'rlari o'qiladi.

⚠ Berns 'Auld Lang Syne' qo'shig'i muallifi
— u butun dunyoda Yangi yilda kuylanadi.

Ro'zadan (Lent) oldingi seshanba.
Rasmiy nomi — 'Shrove Tuesday'.

Uyda qo'ymoch (pancake) pishiriladi.

⚠ Ba'zi shaharlarda 'PANCAKE RACE' bo'ladi:
odamlar qo'lda tovada qo'ymoch ko'tarib
yugurishadi va yo'lda uni havoga otib
ag'darishlari kerak!

⚠⚠ MUHIM FARQ: Britaniyada Onalar kuni
MARTDA, Amerikada esa MAYDA nishonlanadi.

⚠ Britaniyadagi rasmiy nomi —
'Mothering Sunday'.

⚠ 'Mother's Day' — egalik apostrofi
bilan (bitta ona nazarda tutilgandek).

Hazil va aldash kuni.

⚠⚠ QADIMIY QOIDA: hazil faqat TUSHGACHA
(soat 12 gacha) qilinadi. Tushdan keyin
hazil qilgan odamning o'zi 'April Fool'
bo'ladi.

⚠ 'a fool' = ahmoq, masxaraboz.

Brayton — Angliyaning janubiy sohilidagi
dengiz kurorti.

⚠ Britaniyaning eng yirik san'at
festivallaridan biri.

⚠ 'the arts' = san'at (ko'plikda —
barcha turlari: musiqa, teatr, rassomlik).

Mashhur ot poygasi (Berkshir).

⚠ Qirol oilasi har yili qatnashadi.

⚠⚠ Ayollarning KATTA SHLYAPALARI bilan
mashhur — bu yerda shlyapa kiyish MAJBURIY.

⚠ 'a race' = poyga (163-betdagi Cowes Week
matnida ham shu so'z).

Temza daryosidagi eshkak eshish poygasi
(Henley-on-Thames shahri).

⚠ 'a regatta' — italyan tilidan
(Venetsiyadagi qayiq poygasi nomi).

⚠ 162-betdagi 2b mashqi uchun yaxshi misol:
'regatta' — 'regata'.

Londondagi Karib havzasi karnavali.

⚠ Yevropadagi eng yirik ko'cha
bayramlaridan biri.

⚠ 'a carnival' — lotincha 'carne vale'
('go'sht bilan xayrlashuv').

⚠ 160-161-betdagi Chinatown bayramlari
kabi — bu ham ko'chmanchi jamoa an'anasi.

pairs.right: Braemer Royal Highland Gathering  (⚠ kitobda xato: BRAEMAR bo'lishi kerak)
pairs.whyUz:
⚠⚠ KITOB XATOSI: kitobda 'BRAEMER' deb
yozilgan.

To'g'ri yozilishi — BRAEMAR (Shotlandiyaning
Aberdinshir hududidagi qishloq).

Rasmni kattalashtirib tekshirdim — kitobda
aniq 'Braemer' bosilgan.

⚠ 'Highland Games' — Shotland tog'
o'yinlari: og'ir tosh otish, qarag'ay
ustuni ag'darish, volinka chalish.

⚠ 'a gathering' = yig'in, to'planish.

Qovoqdan chiroq yasash, qo'rqinchli
liboslar kiyish.

⚠ Nomi: 'All Hallows' Eve' (Barcha
avliyolar arafasi) dan qisqargan.

⚠ 'an eve' = arafa — dekabrdagi 'New
Year's Eve' bilan bir xil so'z.

'Guy Fawkes Night' ham deyiladi.
Gulxan yoqiladi va salyut otiladi.

⚠ 'a bonfire' = katta gulxan
('bone' + 'fire' — qadimiy shakl).

⚠⚠ QIZIQ: 162-betdagi Lord Mayor's Show ham
NOYABRDA o'tkaziladi. Ya'ni noyabr —
Britaniyada salyut oyi.

⚠ 'an EVE' = arafa (bayramdan oldingi kech).

  New Year's Eve  = 31-dekabr
  Christmas Eve   = 24-dekabr

⚠ 'evening' so'zi bilan bir ildizdan.

⚠ 'New Year's DAY' esa 1-yanvar — boshqa
kun!

exercises.instructionEn: Speaking:  • Which festival interests you most?  • Choose one of the pictures and describe it, then talk about the festival.  • Do you have any interesting festivals in your country?  • Make a Calendar of Events for your country, then choose two or three events and describe them.
exercises.instructionUz: Gapirish:  • Qaysi bayram sizni ko'proq qiziqtiradi?  • Rasmlardan birini tanlang va tasvirlang, so'ng bayram haqida gapiring.  • Mamlakatingizda qiziqarli bayramlar bormi?  • Mamlakatingiz uchun bayramlar taqvimini tuzing, so'ng ikki-uchtasini tasvirlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ TO'RTTA MUHOKAMA SAVOLI.

  ⚠ Oxirgi savol — eng katta vazifa:
  O'ZBEKISTON uchun BAYRAMLAR TAQVIMINI
  tuzish.


1-SAVOL: 'Which festival interests you
          most?'

  ⚠ 'to INTEREST' bu yerda FE'L:
     'The festival INTERESTS me.'
     = Bayram meni qiziqtiradi.

  ⚠ Boshqacha aytish mumkin:
     'I am INTERESTED IN the festival.'
     ⚠ 'interested IN' — 'in' bilan!

  NAMUNA JAVOB:
     'The festival that interests me most
      is the Notting Hill Carnival. I like
      music and dancing, and it is the
      biggest street party in Europe.'


2-SAVOL: rasmni tasvirlash

  NAMUNA JAVOB (D surati):
     'In picture D I can see a lot of
      people dancing around a tall pole.
      There are children and adults. The
      pole is decorated with long ribbons
      and the dancers are holding them.
      They are wearing red and white
      clothes. It is a sunny day and there
      are old houses behind them.

      This is a maypole dance. It happens
      on the 1st of May to celebrate the
      first day of spring.'

  ⚠ RASMNI TASVIRLASh QOLIPI:
     'In the picture I can see ...'
     'There is / There are ...'
     'He/She is wearing ...'
     'In the background there is ...'

  ⚠ Rasmda nima BO'LAYOTGANINI aytganda
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS ishlatiladi:
     'They ARE DANCING.'


3 va 4-SAVOL: O'ZBEKISTON TAQVIMI

  NAMUNA TAQVIM:

     January   — New Year (1-yanvar)
     March     — NAVRUZ (21-mart)
     May       — Xotira va qadrlash kuni
                 (9-may)
     June      — Bolalarni himoya qilish
                 kuni (1-iyun)
     September — Mustaqillik kuni
                 (1-sentabr)
     October   — O'qituvchilar kuni
                 (1-oktabr)
     December  — Konstitutsiya kuni
                 (8-dekabr)

     ⚠ Yana: Ramazon hayiti va Qurbon
     hayiti — oy taqvimi bo'yicha, sanasi
     har yili o'zgaradi.


  NAMUNA TASVIR (Navro'z):

     'The most important festival in
      Uzbekistan is Navruz. It takes place
      on the 21st of March and it
      celebrates the first day of spring.

      Navruz dates back thousands of
      years. People clean their houses,
      wear new clothes and visit their
      relatives.

      The special dish is SUMALAK. Women
      cook it all night in a big pot and
      sing songs while they stir it.

      There are also concerts, games and
      horse races in the streets.'

  ⚠⚠ NAVRUZ — May Day bilan JUDA O'XShASh:

     • ikkalasi ham BAHOR bayrami
     • ikkalasi ham birinchi bahor kunini
       nishonlaydi
     • ikkalasida ham raqs, musiqa va
       maxsus taom bor

  ⚠ Bu o'xshashlikni javobda aytish —
  javobni ancha kuchli qiladi.


⚠ FOYDALI IBORALAR:

  'It takes place on the ... of ...'
  'It dates back to ...'
  'The highlight of the festival is ...'
  'People wear ... and eat ...'
  'It is similar to ... in Britain.'


⚠ SANA AYTISh:

     'on the 21st of March'  (BrE)
     'on March 21st'         (AmE)

  ⚠ 'ON' + aniq sana;
  ⚠ 'IN' + oy ('in March').


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to interest    = qiziqtirmoq
  interested in  = ... ga qiziquvchi
  to describe    = tasvirlamoq
  a description  = tasvir
  in the background = orqa fonda
  an adult       = kattalar
  a relative     = qarindosh
  to stir        = aralashtirmoq
  a pot          = qozon

points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to INTEREST' bu yerda FE'L:
'The festival interests me.'

⚠ Boshqacha: 'I am INTERESTED IN it.'
⚠ 'interested IN' — 'in' bilan!
  'interested in music'  ✓
  'interested for music' ✗

points.en: In picture D I can see a lot of people dancing around a tall pole.
points.uz: D rasmida baland ustun atrofida raqsga tushayotgan ko'p odamni ko'raman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ RASMNI TASVIRLASH QOLIPI:
'In the picture I can see ...'

⚠ Rasmda nima BO'LAYOTGANINI aytganda
PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
  'They ARE DANCING.'
  'She IS WEARING a white dress.'

⚠ 'In the background' = orqa fonda.

points.en: The most important festival in Uzbekistan is Navruz. It takes place on the 21st of March.
points.uz: O'zbekistondagi eng muhim bayram — Navro'z. U 21-martda o'tkaziladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to take place' = o'tkazilmoq
(162-betdagi Lord Mayor matnida ham bor).

⚠ SANA: 'on the 21st OF March' (BrE);
'on March 21st' (AmE).

⚠ 'ON' + aniq sana; 'IN' + oy.

points.en: Navruz dates back thousands of years. It celebrates the first day of spring.
points.uz: Navro'z ming yillarga borib taqaladi. U bahorning birinchi kunini nishonlaydi.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ NAVRUZ va MAY DAY JUDA O'XSHASH:
  • ikkalasi ham BAHOR bayrami
  • ikkalasi ham birinchi bahor kunini
    nishonlaydi
  • ikkalasida ham raqs, musiqa, maxsus taom

⚠ Bu o'xshashlikni javobda aytish javobni
kuchli qiladi.

⚠ 'to date back' — Cowes Week matnidan
olingan ibora.

points.en: The special dish is sumalak. Women cook it all night in a big pot and sing songs while they stir it.
points.uz: Maxsus taom — sumalak. Ayollar uni katta qozonda tun bo'yi pishirishadi va aralashtirar ekan qo'shiq aytishadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'WHILE' + davom etgan harakat.

⚠ 'to stir' = aralashtirmoq.

⚠ 'all night' = tun bo'yi
(157-betdagi 'all year round' kabi).

points.en: Make a Calendar of Events for your country.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Eng katta vazifa — 12 oy uchun taqvim.

⚠ OYLAR HAR DOIM BOSH HARF bilan:
January, March, September.

⚠ O'zbekiston uchun: Navro'z (mart),
Mustaqillik kuni (1-sentabr), Konstitutsiya
kuni (8-dekabr), Ramazon va Qurbon hayitlari
(oy taqvimi bo'yicha).

patterns.formula: [Tadbir] takes place in [vaqt] and dates back to [yil].
patterns.exampleEn: Cowes Week takes place in early August and dates back to 1826.
patterns.exampleUz: Cowes haftaligi avgust boshida o'tkaziladi va 1826-yilga borib taqaladi.

⚠ 'dates back' — HOZIRGI zamonda.
⚠ 'in early August' = avgust boshida.

patterns.formula: In the picture I can see [kim/nima] [fe'l]-ing.
patterns.exampleEn: In picture D I can see a lot of people dancing around a tall pole.
patterns.exampleUz: D rasmida baland ustun atrofida raqsga tushayotgan ko'p odamni ko'raman.

⚠ Rasm tasvirlashning asosiy qolipi.
